scenicChapters.title: German Fairy Tale Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 39 km this is German Fairy Tale Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-building-remains-south-of-gotzing.story: From Osterburken it runs 288 km to Osterburken; allow about 4 h 58 of riding. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
